item.tib: khrid kyi rgyab yig lung gi 'phreng ba
khrid kyi rgyab yig lung gis 'phreng ba
item.coloph: snyan rgyud kyi khrid kyis (kyi) rgyab skyor lung gis (gi)'phreng ba mig 'byed sgron ma ces pa/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyis nyangs stod phyug mo dpal kyi ri ru/ mkha' 'gros bskul nas yi ger bkod pa'o// sku gsum thugs kyi rgya yod/ kho bo bon zhig g.yung drung gling pas/ yos bu lo zla ba'i tshes bcu pa'i nub mo phyug mo dpal ri yis (yi) rig 'dzin kyi gsang phug nas/ srid rgyal tshe bum mda' dar bsnams pa/ sku mdog dkar mo dar dkar gos su gyon pa/ mtho (tho) rangs dngos su sgo phye nas bdan (gdan) drangs/ nyams su blangs shing gsang / 'brug lo zla ba gnyis kyi tshes bcu la/ mtha' bzhi drang srong ye shes rang shar gyis bskul nas/ lung zin snod ldan du mthong / stag gzig gi dkrug yig chen mo las dag par phab/ legs par gtugs/ slob bu snod ldan rnams la lung khrid bskyangs pa yin/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan 'gyur cig dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas myur thob shog/
